method: Gaussian copula for revenue_growth–ebit_margin pair (rho=0.4); independent triangular draws for reinvestment_intensity and discount_rate.  Growth and margin constant within a path; reinvestment = revenue × intensity; FCFF = EBIT×(1−tax) − reinvestment; terminal value via Gordon growth on FY5 FCFF, discounted at path-specific discount rate.
limitations: Triangular distributions symmetrically approximate true driver uncertainty; growth and margin held constant within a path ignoring year-to-year dynamics; reinvestment intensity assumed independent of growth/margin; discount rate held constant per path; terminal value uses constant terminal_g across all paths; no path-dependent capital-structure or content-cycle feedback; correlation limited to the growth–margin pair at fixed rho=0.4; no time-varying volatility structure. Simulation interval is model-conditional DCF distribution, NOT a stock-price prediction.
